author: Unity
description:
Unity Learn’s Getting Started With Shader Graph course helps you understand shader fundamentals and lets you start creating visual effects in Unity. 

Learn how shaders control appearance, explore fragment and vertex shaders, and build effects like highlights, x ray, holograms, vertex displacement, pixelation, dithering, and liquid shaders. 

With modular units, practical examples, and everything you need to create portfolio ready work, this course is a strong next step for developers looking to expand their Unity Shader Graph skills.

Start the course: https://unity3d.info/learn-shader-graph
Try the demo on Unity Play: https://unity3d.info/play-shader-graph
title: Getting started with Shader Graph
